name.ja: ＨＧ 1/144 ガンダムバルバトス コンプリートセット

series.ja: 機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ

brands.ja: HG［ハイグレード］／プレバンガンプラ

description.ja: ガンダム・バルバトス 第１形態～第６形態を再現できるオールインパックが登場！
description.en: An all-in pack that allows you to reproduce Gundam Barbatos 1st to 6th forms is now available!

description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ』より、
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam Iron-Blooded Orphans"

description.ja: 第１～第６形態のガンダム・バルバトスが再現できるオールインパックをＨＧシリーズで商品化。
description.en: An all-in pack that allows you to reproduce the 1st to 6th forms of Gundam and Barbatos has been commercialized in the HG series.

description.ja: ＭＳ本体２機に加え、第１・２・３・４・５・５地上戦仕様・６の各形態を再現する武装／パーツを一式同梱。
description.en: In addition to the two MS bodies, a set of weapons/parts to reproduce the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 5th ground battle specifications, and 6th form is included.

description.ja: 既存商品とはニュアンスが異なる　劇中に忠実な成形色を採用。
description.en: Adopts a molding color that is faithful to the movie, which has a different nuance from existing products.

description.ja: すべての武装／パーツは、ＨＧ ガンダムバルバトスに合わせた設定カラーを成形色で再現し、
description.en: All weapons/parts are reproduced in molding colors to match the HG Gundam Barbatos.

description.ja: 一部パーツは、ＭＳ本体に装着した時のバランスを整えた形状で再現。ＣＧＳモビルワーカー付属。
description.en: Some parts are reproduced in a well-balanced shape when attached to the MS body. CGS mobile worker included.

description.ja: ●　第２～第３形態用肩装甲を、青の成形色で新造！
description.en: ● Newly made shoulder armor for the 2nd and 3rd forms with blue molding color!

description.ja: ＨＧ グレイズ（一般機/指揮官機）に付属していた肩装甲を、新たに青の成形色で新造。
description.en: The shoulder armor that came with the HG Glaze (general machine/commander machine) has been remade with a new blue molding color.

description.ja: 白のホイルシールを使用することで、劇中の設定カラーを再現可能。
description.en: By using the white foil seal, you can reproduce the setting color in the play.

description.ja: ●　第３形態用ワイヤークローが、劇中設定色で新規パーツとして登場！
description.en: ● The wire claw for the third form is now available as a new part in the color set in the play!

description.ja: ＨＧ シュヴァルベグレイズ（マクギリス機）に付属していたワイヤークローを、クローを白、基部を紫の成形色で新造。
description.en: The wire claw that came with the HG Schwalbe Glaze (McGillis machine) has been remade with a white claw and purple base.

description.ja: 劇中設定イメージを再現。
description.en: Reproduce the setting image from the play.

description.ja: ●　太刀（柄付き）も付属！
description.en: ● A long sword (with a handle) is also included!

description.ja: ＨＧ クタン参型に付属した、太刀（柄付き）を同梱。劇中シーンを再現可能。
description.en: Includes the long sword (with handle) that comes with the HG Kutan Sangata. Scenes from the play can be reproduced.

description.ja: ●　第５形態用腰部ブースターを、ＨＧ ガンダムバルバトスにあわせた形状、劇中設定色に準じたカラーで新造！
description.en: ● The lumbar booster for the 5th form has been newly manufactured with a shape that matches the HG Gundam Barbatos and a color that matches the color set in the play!

description.ja: 腰部アーム付属！
description.en: Waist arm included!

description.ja: 腰部ブースターは、ＨＧ ガンダムバルバトスにあわせた形状、劇中にあわせて白とグレーの成形色で新造。
description.en: The lumbar booster has a new shape that matches the HG Gundam Barbatos, and is molded in white and gray colors to match the movie.

description.ja: ＨＧ クタン参型に付属した、腰部アームも同梱。
description.en: Also included is the waist arm that comes with the HG Kutan Model.

description.ja: ●　既存商品とはニュアンスが異なる　劇中に忠実な成形色を採用！
description.en: ● Adopts a molding color that is faithful to the movie, with a different nuance from existing products!

description.en: Mace / Left arm parts for 1st and 2nd forms / Smooth cannon / Shoulder armor for 2nd and 3rd forms / Wire claw for 3rd form

description.en: Shoulder armor for 4th to 5th forms / Tachi / Tachi (with handle) / Chest reactive armor / Arm mortar / Waist arm
